resources.string: What is new in each version

string-array.name: changelog_1_2_0_bullets
string-array.item: The player now scrolls: swipe up and a card with the song lyrics appears.
The line being sung is highlighted and the card follows it on its own. Tap a line to jump to that moment.
The corner button opens the lyrics full screen.
The lead time and text size configured in Settings also apply to the card.

resources.string: The navigation bar no longer covers the player

string-array.name: changelog_1_1_3_bullets
string-array.item: With the classic navigation bar, the bar was drawn over the expanded player and hid the lyrics, queue and more row. It now hides while the player is open, just like the floating bar does.

resources.string: The lyrics button is visible again

string-array.name: changelog_1_1_2_bullets
string-array.item: The player cover now takes only the leftover space, so the lyrics, queue and more buttons never fall off the screen.
Those buttons are now shown in landscape too.

resources.string: Spoty in Spanish and lyrics settings

string-array.name: changelog_1_1_0_bullets
string-array.item: Rioplatense Spanish as the default language, with English as fallback.
System / Light / Dark theme mode in Appearance.
Lyrics lead-time slider so you can read each line before it is sung.

resources.string: Spoty is an Android Spotify client built for Premium accounts. Play your music through librespot, control other devices with Spotify Connect, follow synced lyrics, add home-screen widgets, back up your settings and pick a theme that follows the album art or the system colors.

string-array.name: changelog_1_0_0_bullets
string-array.item: Playback through librespot for Spotify Premium accounts.
Theme that follows the album art or the system colors.
